question: Who won the men's singles Yonex Sunrise India Open 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lakshya Sen.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lakshya Sen won the men’s singles title at the **Yonex Sunrise India Open 2022.**
 
• He secured his maiden** Super 500 title.**
 
• Lakshya Sen defeated the reigning **world champion Loh Kean Yew of Singapore in the final.**
 
• The victory was achieved in straight games, showcasing his dominance in the match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty** won the men’s doubles title at the same tournament.
 
• **Mohammad Ahsan** is a renowned Indonesian badminton player, known for his achievements in men’s doubles.
 
• The **Yonex Sunrise India Open is part of the BWF World Tour Super 500 series**, attracting top international players.
